verdicts.quote: "Word pair" can mean two different things, and they lead to very different tools. Do you mean two words that sit right next to each other in the text, like "ice cream" or "of the", or any two words that appear together in the same sentence, even with other words between them?
verdicts.reason: The agent's messages ask a clarifying question about what word pairs mean and never raise quality goals, arc42 or ADRs.
